title: Transportation Expenses Paid and Not Paid — Rental Reimbursement Coverage
content:
Rental Reimbursement Coverage pays transportation expenses while the insured vehicle is out of use after a covered loss. Which charges count is the same under every Cardinal Point Rental Reimbursement package ($20/$600, $25/$750, $30/$900, $40/$1,200, $50/$1,500 and $60/$1,800).

## Charges and their treatment

| Charge or substitute | Treatment under every package |
|---|---|
| Rental vehicle | Paid for a vehicle of a class comparable to the damaged vehicle, within the daily limit |
| Ride-hailing or public transit fares instead of a rental | Reimbursed, within the daily limit |
| Mileage charges | Not covered |
| Fuel | Not covered |
| A rental company's damage waiver | Not covered |

## Condition, judgement, result

- **Condition:** a charge appears on a rental bill or receipt submitted under the coverage.
- **Judgement:** is it the day's rental of a comparable-class vehicle, or a ride-hailing or transit fare taken instead of a rental? Or is it mileage, fuel or the rental company's damage waiver?
- **Result:** the first group counts toward the day within the daily limit; mileage, fuel and the damage waiver are not covered.

## Basis questions answered

**Is a larger vehicle than the damaged one paid?** The class paid is the class comparable to the damaged vehicle, and always within the daily limit.

**May the named insured use ride-hailing or public transit instead of renting?** Yes. Ride-hailing or public transit fares are reimbursed instead of a rental, within the daily limit.

**Is a rental company's damage waiver bought at the counter paid?** No. A rental company's damage waiver is not covered under any package, nor are mileage charges or fuel.

## Hypothetical receipt

A hypothetical one-day bill shows a comparable-class rental of USD 24.00 including taxes, a fuel refill of USD 15.00 and a damage waiver of USD 12.00. Only the USD 24.00 rental counts toward that day under Rental Reimbursement Coverage, within the package's daily limit; the fuel and the damage waiver are not covered.
